notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added music to the credits
- Fixed an issue where the opening the options menu while in the credits would crash the game
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't unlock the "Go Outside Now," "Finishing Fast, Are We?" "Overachiever," and "Stop Cheating" achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
We've updated the game to patch some bugs that have showed up on the first day of release!
- Fixed a bug where a hitbox in Sylvano Mountain Base was too short, allowing players to clip through a wall.
- Fixed a bug where after completion of the game, starting from Lurielle Village, backing out, and then going to Sacred Summit would cause the timer to start from 0:00 on the level.
- Fixed a bug where the credits cutscene would play audio at max volume, even if volume was turned down.
- Added a Final Time counter to the credits, so you can easily share your best time!

Stay tuned, we're working on a leaderboard system for the best times throughout the game!

notes.title: The Speedrun Competition has Officially Begun!
notes.content:
Welcome to Steam Next Fest! 
As previously mentioned, we are hosting a fun Speedrunning Competition with our demo. Here are the official details below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/cee7530ab4ca8d9ba2d9b522aed734b84a38545d.png
Participants that record a run of playing the Echoes of Eldoria Demo and post it to one of these social media sites with the hashtag #EOESpeedrun will be entered. These sites include:

 Youtube
 X
 Instagram
 Tiktok


Be sure to upload on a platform you check often, as winners will be contacted through the comments!

OFFICIAL RULES:
- You may not skip levels during a run (using the menu to go to the Mountain Base without having completed the tutorial)
- The game cannot be closed during a run
- The run begins when the timer starts in the tutorial level and ends when you receive your final time in the wishlist screen
- Use of the game's natural bugs and glitches is allowed to speed up gameplay
- Use of external programs are not allowed (ex. CheatEngine, WeMod)
- We will individually review all entries, so do not worry if your timer does not work properly
- Runs that violate these rules will not be considered for prizes
- Each contestant will only have their top submission considered
- All submissions must be submitted before March 3rd at 10:00 AM PT

You can submit as many entries as you'd like! Once you are entered, there's nothing much to worry about until the end of the competition. Once the competition is over, we will go through the submissions and find the Top 3 winners!

These winners will receive:
1st Place: A $100 USD Steam Gift Card + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!
2nd Place: A $50 USD Steam Gift Card + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!
3rd Place: A $20 USD Steam Gift Card  + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!

The competition will end on March 3rd, in accordance with Next Fest. Good luck, and we hope to see your submission!

notes.title: Official Steam Next Fest Announcement! + Speedrunning Competition
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're excited to announce that we will officially be participating in Steam's February Next Fest 2025! With it, we have implemented various new improvements to our demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/aa8f8ba0dd7ccb682d43c2b2a30de81d56e76b7c.png

In addition, throughout the duration of Steam Next Fest, we will be running our Echoes of Eldoria Next Fest Speedrunning Competition! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/9fb0cc03185e3a79cbf1412537602bcce9ade4d4.png

Throughout Reddit, X, Instagram, Tiktok, and Youtube, participants who record gameplay speedrunning our Next Fest Demo and tag it with #EOESpeedrun will be entered. By the end of Next Fest, the winners will be awarded:
1st Place: 100 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of Echoes of Eldoria!
2nd Place: 50 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of Echoes of Eldoria!
3rd Place: 20 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of Echoes of Eldoria!
We look forward to seeing your gameplay clips and the start of Next Fest. Stay tuned for more updates on the Speedrunning Competition!
- Roobec
